NBA DFS Picks for Thursday, November 12 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Thursday, November 12 · 4 games · First game 7:00 PM ET · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 12, 9:31 AM ET

Cade Cunningham (DET) is the top-projected player on the Thursday, November 12 DraftKings main slate at 51.4 DraftKings points for $9,600. Cooper Flagg (DAL, 43.9, $10,100) and Anthony Davis (WAS, 42.4, $9,000) are next.

Daniss Jenkins (DET) returns the most per dollar among players projected for at least 20 points: 6.18 projected points per $1,000 at $5,000.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 12, 9:31 AM ET run of the Splash Play NBA model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are run, and NBA projections move with every injury report, so check the time above before you build.

How to use these numbers

A projection is a starting point. Salary decides who fits: the Pts/$1K column shows what each player returns for his price. A late scratch changes the minutes and shots of everyone around him, so the numbers from an earlier run can be out of date by the first game.
